# Copilot Instructions — codescape

## Project
Interactive programming concepts explorer built with Expo + Expo Router.
A mobile app where users can browse programming concepts organized by language/topic,
read detailed explanations, see code examples, and try them interactively.

## Stack
- Expo + Expo Router (latest)
- TypeScript (strict mode)
- React Native
- No backend, no database — all data in src/data/*.json
- Jest + React Native Testing Library for testing

## Folder Structure
```
src/
  components/    → reusable components, each with its test file alongside
  data/          → one JSON file per section (javascript.json, python.json, etc.)
  theme/         → colors.ts, typography.ts, spacing.ts
  hooks/         → custom hooks
app/
  index.tsx      → Home screen with section list
  [section]/
    index.tsx    → concept list for that section
    [concept].tsx → concept detail screen
docs/
  specs/         → specs generated by the PM Agent
.github/
  instructions/  → agent role instructions
```

## Concept Data Shape
```json
{
  "id": "string",
  "title": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "content": "string",
  "codeExample": "string",
  "tryItCode": "string"
}
```

## Coding Conventions
- Functional components only, always with explicit TypeScript interfaces for props
- Separate logic from presentation using custom hooks
- StyleSheet.create() always — no inline styles
- Colors, spacing, and typography always from src/theme/
- Every new component must have a corresponding test file
- Touch targets minimum 44x44px
- accessibilityLabel on all interactive elements

## Agent Team
This project uses a specialized agent team. Each agent has a role and scope:
- **PM Agent** → writes specs from feature requests into docs/specs/
- **Frontend Architect** → component structure, routing, data layer
- **UX Designer** → styles, theming, accessibility, dark mode
- **QA Engineer** → tests, coverage, edge cases

When working on a feature, follow this order:
PM Agent → Frontend Architect → UX Designer → QA Engineer → Implementation
